title: Emrys and the Regiment
author: Xanthe Voss
blurb: Mara Dravenmoor, a battlefield nurse keeping a ledger of the names officers omit, has spent five years learning which silences keep people safe. Then a stranger arrives carrying unmistakable handwriting from a supposed corpse — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must finish the work while the workshop still stands, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
